nodes.label: RiskWise Project
nodes.author: Kaushik Parthasarathy
nodes.rationale: Maritime supply chain intelligence platform built by Manus AI, undergoing portability and style rework to remove vendor lock-in and match Kaushik's engineering preferences. Core value: evaluate shipping route risk via multi-agent AI on real-time global disruption data.

nodes.label: Athena Agent (Researcher)
nodes.rationale: Researcher agent that scans global disruption sources, extracts relevant events for a given route, and populates the intelligence context used by Hermes for risk scoring. Also runs as hourly background scan job.

nodes.label: Hermes Agent (Risk Modeler)
nodes.rationale: Risk modeling agent that calculates a 0-100 risk score across 4 factors (weather, labor, geopolitical, congestion) and generates a risk narrative from Athena's intelligence context.

nodes.label: Apollo Agent (Route Optimizer)
nodes.rationale: Route optimization agent that generates alternative shipping routes when risk score exceeds 50. Produces text response with cost impact, transit time, and safety rationale. Map visualization of alternatives is deferred/removed from MVP scope.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Orchestration (Athena/Hermes/Apollo)
nodes.rationale: Sequential agent pipeline: Athena researches disruptions, Hermes models risk, Apollo optimizes routes. Orchestration logic in server/agents.ts is preserved across the rework; only the LLM backend is swapped.

nodes.label: JWT Auth (email+password)
nodes.rationale: Replaces Manus OAuth. Standard email+password auth using jose for JWT signing and bcryptjs for password hashing. Removes dependency on Manus OAuth server and SDK. JWT payload: { userId, email }. httpOnly cookie session.

nodes.label: LLM Configuration via Env Vars
nodes.rationale: Replace hardcoded Manus Forge/Gemini endpoint with RISKWISE_LLM_BASE_URL, RISKWISE_LLM_API_KEY, RISKWISE_LLM_MODEL env vars. Enables Ollama for local dev and any OpenAI-compatible provider in prod. No Python LiteLLM dep. invokeLLM interface stays unchanged so agents.ts is unaffected.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Migration (from MySQL)
nodes.rationale: Switch from mysql2/MySQL to postgres driver and drizzle pg-core. Drizzle config dialect set to postgresql. onDuplicateKeyUpdate replaced with onConflictDoUpdate. Table/column names preserved. Fresh migrations written for PG.

nodes.label: node-cron Scheduler (replaces Manus Heartbeat)
nodes.rationale: In-process cron using node-cron to fire Athena hourly scan. Replaces Manus heartbeat service. Athena scan handler no longer needs req/res Express signature. heartbeat_jobs table removed from schema.

nodes.label: Pino Structured Logger
nodes.rationale: Replaces scattered console.* with pino JSON structured logs. Request ID middleware generates x-request-id via nanoid and propagates through logger child contexts. Log shape: { level, time, msg, requestId, service: 'riskwise' }. Enables queryable production logs.

nodes.label: Cyberpunk Refined Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: Keep cyberpunk identity (Orbitron/Rajdhani/Share Tech Mono, oklch tokens, dark base, Tailwind) but apply restraint: glow utilities only on active/focus/status states, neon-pulse only on system status indicator and critical alerts, font-sans (Rajdhani) for body text, font-mono only for data readouts/coords/timestamps, generous card padding 24-32px, remove scanlines utility.

nodes.label: Zod Validation at HTTP Boundary
nodes.rationale: Every tRPC procedure has a Zod input schema. Validation at the router layer, not sprinkled in services. env.ts validated with Zod on boot — server refuses to start if required vars missing. Consistent error shapes for validation failures.

nodes.label: Console + Webhook Notifications
nodes.rationale: notifyOwner() logs at pino warn level and optionally POSTs JSON to RISKWISE_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL (compatible with Slack, Discord, Make.com, n8n). Replaces Manus notification API. Same interface preserved.

nodes.label: Architecture Portability Decision
nodes.rationale: Remove all Manus-specific integrations (OAuth, storage proxy, notifications, LLM, heartbeat) so app runs on any Node host. Tradeoff: lose Manus convenience, gain independence, flexibility, cost control, and deployability without a Manus account.

nodes.label: tRPC + Drizzle ORM
nodes.rationale: Core type-safe stack preserved across rework. tRPC end-to-end types stay intact. Drizzle migrated from mysql-core to pg-core but query patterns unchanged.

nodes.label: Manus Platform Lock-In
nodes.rationale: Original app built on Manus AI platform with hardcoded dependencies: Manus OAuth, Forge LLM API, storage proxy, notification SDK, heartbeat cron, Gemini model. All being removed in portability rework.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Setup
nodes.rationale: One-time setup: uv tool install graphifyy, /graphify ., graphify hook install, graphify claude install. Post-commit hook auto-rebuilds AST layer. graphify-out/ contains graph.html, graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md. manifest.json and cost.json in .gitignore.

nodes.label: MVP Scope Decision
nodes.rationale: Core features: route evaluation, disruptions feed, history. Remove: alternate route map visualization (keep Apollo text response), trend sparklines (deferred), fancy agent terminal (simplified to pass/fail). Tradeoff: lose visual richness, gain faster shipping and maintainability.

nodes.label: Structured Error Handling
nodes.rationale: Error codes defined in server/_core/errors.ts: VALIDATION_FAILED, NOT_FOUND, LLM_ERROR, DB_ERROR, AUTH_FAILED. All tRPC errors use TRPCError with these codes as message prefix. Central Express error handler at bottom of index.ts. Consistent { error: { code, message, requestId } } response shape.

nodes.label: Next.js Migration Feasibility
nodes.rationale: Deferred. React + Express stays for now. Next.js migration estimated at ~6h after portability rework: App Router replaces Wouter, Server Components for agent orchestration, API routes replace Express. Manus lock-in must be removed first. Decision: complete restyle first, reconsider in session 3+.

hyperedges.label: Portability Rework: Auth + LLM + DB + Cron
Observability Stack: Pino + Request IDs + Error Codes
